answer: Aliases may scatter like seeds on a zephyr, but each agent must lock $100 before bidding, and its bond stays frozen for 30 days after its last job. Every signed bid enters an audit thread, so deleting an account cannot release its bond early. Even at the nadir of demand, 10,000 fake bidders require $1 million immobilized for that period. The defense makes each eligible identity consume capital, so multiplying names cannot multiply bidding access for free.
